
{{alias}}( x )
    Computes the hyperbolic arcsecant of a single-precision floating-point
    number.

    The domain of `x` is restricted to `[0, 1]`. For `x` outside of this
    interval, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    x: number
        Input value.

    Returns
    -------
    y: number
        Hyperbolic arcsecant.

    Examples
    --------
    > var y = {{alias}}( 1.0 )
    0.0
    > y = {{alias}}( 0.5 )
    ~1.317
    > y = {{alias}}( NaN )
    NaN

    See Also
    --------
